clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Craven Drok keeps to the Cleft of Shadow and seeks travelers for a delicate matter. He wants them to consider how the Alliance sees the Horde.

Craven Drok avoids Orgrimmar's sunlit avenues and wanders the winding paths beneath the city. The Cleft of Shadow draws warlocks, rogues, and practitioners of less honorable trades. Drok keeps out of sight and hires passersby to handle discreet errands, including one about the Horde's standing with the Alliance.
